name: qrsuisse-agents-workspace
description: Workspace root of the QR Suisse SDK, CLI and MCP server (not published).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @qrsuisse/sdk && npm run build --workspace qrsuisse && npm run build --workspace @qrsuisse/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @qrsuisse/sdk && tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
